findings.cursor: Removed in 1.0.7. @cursor/sdk@1.0.40 LICENSE.md reserved rights and no redistribution grant was established, so the SDK, its runtime packages and the Cursor assistant provider are no longer distributed. third_party/distribution-policy.json enforces the exclusion.
findings.codex: Pinned upstream NOTICE retained and byte-matched. Source-lock inventory retained separately. Per-platform packages inspected (macOS, Linux, Windows x64): the optional LGPL voice runtime is not used by FDO and is excluded from distribution; the Linux bubblewrap helper (LGPL-2.0-or-later) has its vendored source in the Linux native-source archive. Helper binaries (rg, zsh, Windows sandbox executables) and a native SBOM remain open.
findings.typescript: NOTICE.txt and LICENSE present in each of the darwin-arm64, darwin-x64, linux-x64 and win32-x64 7.0.2 packages and byte-identical (see native-ai-platform-packages.json); the notice is collected from the installed package for each target.
findings.lazy-val: Pinned tree and npm package carry no license notice and no rights-holder authorization was obtained. Replaced in 1.0.7 by an original in-tree package (packages/lazy-val); the upstream evidence is retained only as the audit record.
findings.git: Pinned build dependency manifest and Git submodule confirmed. A corresponding-source archive per target is built and verified by scripts/release/native-source.cjs (policy third_party/native-source.json); CI review of the produced archives remains.
